why: DELETE /albums/{id} documents only 204, but an id that is missing or not the caller's answers 400 {"message":"Not found or no album.delete access"}: requireAccess in server/src/utils/access.ts throws BadRequestException (https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/v3.3.5/server/src/utils/access.ts).

DELETE /api-keys/{id} documents only 204, but an id that is missing or not the caller's answers 400 {"message":"API Key not found"}: delete in server/src/services/api-key.service.ts (https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/v3.3.5/server/src/services/api-key.service.ts) throws BadRequestException.

DELETE /tags/{id} documents only 204, but an id that is missing or not the caller's answers 400 {"message":"Not found or no tag.delete access"}: requireAccess in server/src/utils/access.ts throws BadRequestException (https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/v3.3.5/server/src/utils/access.ts).

GET /api-keys/me documents only 200, but a caller signed in by session rather than API key answers 403 {"message":"Not authenticated with an API Key"}: getMine in server/src/services/api-key.service.ts (https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/v3.3.5/server/src/services/api-key.service.ts) throws ForbiddenException.
